title: GroundedAnswer
description: The final output of the pipeline: answer text plus status plus citations plus evidence traceability. This is the Backend <-> Generation contract (Section 14).

status.description: 'answered' when grounding accepted the evidence as sufficient. 'clarification_needed' when EvidenceBundle.confidence_status was 'ambiguous'. 'insufficient_data' when it was 'low_confidence' or grounding found the evidence inadequate even though a procedure was resolved.

answer_text.description: The generated answer. Empty string when status is 'clarification_needed' or 'insufficient_data' — use clarification_prompt instead in those cases.

clarification_prompt.description: The question to show the user when status is 'clarification_needed' (e.g. naming the two ambiguous_candidates from EvidenceBundle) or 'insufficient_data' (asking them to rephrase). Null when status is 'answered'.

citations.description: Every citation backing answer_text. Must be empty when status is not 'answered'.

evidence_bundle_id.description: ID of the EvidenceBundle this answer was generated from, for full audit traceability.
